## Details

<a id="ai_chase"></a>
### [`ai_chase`](../../../../src/actor/enemy_ai_states.asm#L13) `$22FA`

*label*

AI chase (state $14) of a computer enemy. wake_idle_enemies sets it when the enemy stands idle. measure_distance_to_bruce gives bruce_dist_y = |dy| (at most $30, bit 7 = Bruce is lower) and bruce_dist_x = |dx| (at most $30, bit 7 = Bruce is to the right). - No floor: walk on along a ladder or vine, else fall. - |dy| >= $10: Bruce lower: walk on in the facing direction; Bruce higher: face him and recover. - Same level, not facing Bruce: |dx| >= $21 turn around and walk, else back off (state $15). - Same level, facing Bruce: the attack decision (ai_facing_bruce). The timer stays the same while the enemy walks.

- **Jumped to from:** [`actor_recover`](actor_timed_actions.md#actor_recover)
